tasks.short: Advise clients on how counseling could help.

steps.what: Advise clients on how they could be helped by counseling.
Write the counseling note of the advice she gave the client.

tasks.design: She advises the client in the room on how counseling could help, then writes the counseling note herself. No tool is added, and nothing about that counseling advice is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: How counseling could help this client does not reduce to a stored rule.
tasks.enabler_now: Faster coding does not remove the conversation in which she gives that advice.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong suggestion can harm the client, and the counseling note is a session note.
tasks.human_edge: She decides how this client could be helped, and she says it in the room.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still advises the client and still writes the counseling note.

reach.task: Say which observation she already holds for this one client.
reach.learn: Which observation is already written, so the counseling advice does not ask the client to repeat it.

evidence.claim: Advising a client on how counseling could help stays with the psychologist. Teaching and advising in this group stay manual.
Session notes and test results are health data.

assumptions: The counseling conversation stays in the room. She writes the counseling note afterwards for her own record and does not send that note outside the organisation.
The conversation step is 72 because the in-person means share is 71.4. The note step is 28, covering documents, screens, mail, and the workbook.
There is no structured input and no tool, so there is no field map to keep and the upkeep allowance is zero. No new system means no works-council consultation and no new access.
unknowns: Whether a separate documentation task at this employer already covers the counseling note.
research_questions: Which part of the counseling advice the client must hear before the session ends.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a day of counseling advice she still holds the conversation and still writes the note, so the saving on this task is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct and evaluate intern patient work.

steps.what: Direct and coordinate staff and interns engaged in patient assessment and treatment.
Evaluate those activities and write what the intern should change.

tasks.design: She directs and coordinates staff and interns while they are engaged in patient assessment and treatment, then evaluates those activities in her own supervision record. No tool is added, and nothing about that direction or that evaluation is drafted by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether an intern's patient assessment and treatment are sound is a judgement, not a stored rule.
tasks.enabler_now: Faster coding does not remove the room in which she directs the interns.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong direction can harm the patient, and the supervision record can hold session content.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what the intern should change in the patient work, and she says it to the intern.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still directs the interns and still writes the evaluation.

reach.task: State which assessment result she already holds for this one patient.
reach.learn: Which result the intern should not repeat.

evidence.claim: Directing interns and evaluating their patient assessment and treatment stays a judgement with the psychologist.
Session notes and test results are health data.

assumptions: She directs the interns in the room and writes the evaluation herself. She does not send the supervision record outside the organisation.
The direction step is 68 because the in-person means share is 67.6. The evaluation step is 32, covering documents, screens, mail, and the workbook.
There is no structured input and no tool, so there is no field map to keep and the upkeep allowance is zero. No new system means no works-council consultation and no new access.
unknowns: How many interns she directs in a week at this employer.
research_questions: Which change in the intern's patient work she must see before the evaluation can close.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a week of intern supervision she still directs the patient work in the room and still writes the evaluation, so the saving on this task is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise and train interns and counselors.

steps.what: Prepare the training for interns, clinicians in training, and other counselors.
Supervise and train those interns, clinicians, and counselors.

tasks.design: She prepares the training for interns, clinicians in training, and other counselors, then supervises and trains them herself. No tool is added, and nothing about that training is prepared or delivered by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: What an intern or another counselor still needs to learn does not reduce to a stored rule.
tasks.enabler_now: Faster coding does not take over the room in which she supervises and trains them.
tasks.still_hard: A weak training session can leave a clinician unsafe with a client, and a case used in the room can be a session note.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what this intern, clinician, or counselor must practise, and she trains them in the room.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still prepares the training and still runs it.

reach.task: Name one method she already uses with a client this intern will see.
reach.learn: Which method the training should not reteach for that client.

evidence.claim: Supervising and training interns, clinicians, and other counselors stays with the psychologist.
Session notes and test results are health data.

assumptions: She writes the training outline, then supervises and trains in the room. She does not hand the training to a machine, and she does not send the outline outside the organisation.
The training session is 71 because the in-person means share is 70.4. The outline step is 29, covering documents, screens, mail, and the workbook.
There is no structured input and no tool, so there is no field map to keep and the upkeep allowance is zero. No new system means no works-council consultation and no new access.
unknowns: Whether the training outline is kept with the intern's file or only used in the room.
research_questions: Which skill the intern must show before this training session can close.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a training day she still writes the outline and still supervises the interns, clinicians, and counselors in the room, so the saving on this task is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Refer clients to other specialists, institutions, or support services as necessary.
Write her referral note naming those specialists, institutions, and support services.

tasks.design: She refers the client in the room to other specialists, institutions, or support services when that is necessary, and writes her own referral note. No tool is added. She does not transmit a dossier outside the organisation, and nothing about the referral is drafted by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether a client needs another specialist, institution, or support service does not reduce to a stored rule.
tasks.enabler_now: Faster coding does not decide the referral or carry the client's session note to anyone else.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong referral can harm the client. The referral note can hold session content, and sending it outside the organisation would move that health data.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether a referral is necessary, and she tells the client in the room.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still decides the referral with the client and still writes the note.

reach.task: Name the assessment she can take for this one client.
reach.learn: Whether that assessment is the specialist this referral needs.

evidence.claim: Choosing whether to refer a client, and to which specialist, institution, or support service, stays a judgement with the psychologist.
Session notes and test results are health data.

assumptions: She decides the referral with the client in the room and writes the referral note for her own record. She does not transmit a dossier to a specialist, an institution, or a support service. There is no release step.
The referral conversation is 62 because the in-person means share is 61.2. The note step is 38, covering documents, screens, mail, and the workbook.
There is no structured input and no tool, so there is no field map to keep and the upkeep allowance is zero. No new system means no works-council consultation and no new access.
unknowns: Whether the client, after the conversation, contacts the specialist without a note from her.
research_questions: Which specialist the client can actually reach before she names the referral.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When a referral is necessary she still decides it with the client and still writes the note herself, so the saving on this task is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still advises clients on counseling, still directs interns on patient assessment and treatment, still trains counselors, and still decides each referral. Nothing is drafted for her.
reach: The school psychologist says which observation she already holds for one client this psychologist is advising.
The clinical neuropsychologist says which assessment result she already holds for one patient an intern is treating.
skills_to_grow: Judging how counseling could help this client.
Evaluating an intern's patient assessment without taking over the treatment.
Naming a specialist, institution, or support service the client can actually reach.
role.ambitious_version: She still makes the counseling advice, the intern evaluation, the training, and the referral herself. The conversations stay in the room.
